race.description: Sister City Rotorua Racing Club Hcp (C1)
race.comment: DON'S PARTY (3) consistent gelding who looks to have further upside after the two good runs this time in. Can make further progress as he gets out in trip and maps to get every chance. RIBBLE LACE (4) racing well in his two runs back and a win looks imminent. Sat on the speed with a close up third over 1600m at Newcastle. Senior rider goes on and has the right figures to take this out. DERRY CITY FELIX (6) lone victory came at this track and trip last March and can show up today at his third run back. Can tag the speed from the good gate and take a hand in the finish. SMICHOV (5) has gone to a new level this prep and gets the blinkers added today. Doesn't have to improve much to take this out.
